metadata.title: Schools in Tornado Alley Without Storm Shelters
metadata.description:
Moore tornado destroyed two elementary schools. The cause: collapse of school buildings without reinforced storm shelters.

Failure chain: School day → EF5 tornado → No safe room → Walls and roof collapse → Children trapped

Related episode: The Lake That Released a Cloud of Carbon Dioxide — https://youtu.be/n-EezRRsuOA

Series — Natural Hazards vs. Engineering: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdrG62GTUxOM

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — 2013 Moore tornado — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2013_Moore_tornado
• NOAA — tgen3 (cited by Wikipedia) — https://www.spc.noaa.gov/publications/broyles/tgen3.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
